_about: MiniMax H3 (hosted API) prompts for scene 2, one per mode. t2v stands alone; flf describes the motion between pinned first/last frames; ref names reference images in the order tools/minimax_h3.py sends them (--map puts the blocking map first). Filter-safe wording per F2-07.

2-02.t2v: Cinematic, photoreal, widescreen. Dawn. Across a quiet street, a 22-year-old woman of mixed Cherokee and Black heritage, warm brown skin, high cheekbones, thick dark hair in two thick braids, worn brown leather jacket, gray tank top, dark jeans, scuffed boots, tribal tattoos on both arms and a small feather tattoo on the left side of her neck only, sits alone on the top step of an ornate Chinese-style church with a red-tiled roof, red trim, tan stucco walls and a columned entrance with dark wooden double doors. She is bent all the way forward at the waist, head drooping and slowly bobbing, drifting in and out, otherwise completely still. A small blue tent with a blue tarp sits on the left of the steps; a light tan tent with no tarp sits on the right. A worn blanket and a backpack rest beside the doors. The camera slowly zooms in from across the street, steady, no shake. As it closes in, a long flat strip of foil and a small torch lighter become visible on the step by her boots. First sunlight warms the roof tiles; she and the steps stay in cool blue shade. Sound: a broken, off-key, pained mumble-hum from her, faint at a distance and growing as we close in; quiet dawn street tone. Gritty but tender, no text on screen.
2-02.flf: The camera slowly and steadily zooms in from across the quiet dawn street toward the young woman bent forward on the top step of the church, her head drooping and slowly bobbing, otherwise still. As we close in, a long flat strip of foil and a small torch lighter become visible on the step by her boots. First sunlight on the roof tiles; she stays in cool blue shade. Sound: her broken, pained mumble-hum growing louder as we approach. Photoreal, cinematic.
2-02.ref: Reference image 1 is a top-down staging map: follow its layout and the camera arrow, but never show the map. Reference image 2 is the woman. Dawn. Across a quiet street, the woman from reference image 2 sits alone on the top step of an ornate Chinese-style church with a red-tiled roof, red trim, tan stucco walls and a columned entrance with dark wooden double doors, bent all the way forward at the waist, head drooping and slowly bobbing, otherwise completely still. A small blue tent with a blue tarp on the left of the steps, a light tan tent with no tarp on the right. The camera slowly zooms in from across the street; as it closes in, a long flat strip of foil and a small torch lighter become visible on the step by her boots. First sun on the roof tiles, she and the steps in cool blue shade. Sound: her broken, pained mumble-hum, growing as we close in. Photoreal, cinematic, widescreen, no text.

2-03.t2v: Cinematic, photoreal, widescreen. Low-angle close-up from the lower steps of an ornate church, looking up at a 22-year-old woman of mixed Cherokee and Black heritage, warm brown skin, thick dark hair in two thick braids, worn brown leather jacket, small feather tattoo on the left side of her neck only, framed from the neck up as she hangs forward on the top step. Her eyes are half-closed and heavy, her lips twisted as if it hurts her to hum. A thin glistening string of saliva hangs from her chin. Behind and above her: the top of a columned entrance and the church's name lettering, warm in the first sun, while her face stays in cool blue shade. The camera holds still and lingers. Sound: her broken, off-key mumble-hum, close and raw. Intimate, no readable text.
2-03.flf: The camera holds low and still, looking up at the young woman's face as she hangs forward on the church steps, eyes half-closed and heavy, lips twisted as if it hurts her to hum, a thin glistening string of saliva hanging from her chin. The church entrance and lettering glow warm above her in the first sun; her face stays in cool shade. Sound: her pained mumble-hum, close and raw. Photoreal, cinematic.

Above her, the top of the columned entrance and the church's name lettering, warm in the first sun; her face in cool blue shade. The camera holds still. Sound: her pained mumble-hum, close and raw. Photoreal, cinematic, widescreen, no readable text.

2-04.t2v: Cinematic, photoreal, widescreen. Close-up of the chin of a young woman with warm brown skin and thick dark braids as she hangs forward on the concrete steps of a church at dawn. The camera tilts slowly down, following a glistening string of saliva from her chin to the step, where a drop lands on a small torch lighter lying on its side and rolls off onto a long, flat strip of foil. The foil catches the early light along its length, the only bright thing in the frame. At the edge of the step, a small curled photograph is half-tucked under the concrete. Sound: her mumble-hum thins and fades to silence. Quiet and sad, no text.
